questions.key_step: Subtract S/2 twice to bring out T; carry the recurrences a_n, b_n.
questions.justification: Long recurrence plus two index-shifting subtractions where a slip is fatal and no options to check; near 2025-P1-Q12 (L4) in format but far more routine, so L3.

questions.key_step: Rationalise and telescope after finding a, d.
questions.justification: Standard rationalisation after solving a,d; routine chain, near 2025-P2-Q15 (L4) but much simpler.

questions.key_step: Inclusion-exclusion count of multiples of 3 and 11 in 1000-2799.
questions.justification: Standard inclusion-exclusion with floor counts; routine but numerical.

questions.key_step: Split odd/even-placed terms into polynomial sums.
questions.justification: Odd/even split then two polynomial sums; routine chain, heavy arithmetic only.

questions.key_step: Reciprocal A.P. + G.P. give y=sqrt2, x+z=4 sqrt2.
questions.justification: Reciprocal A.P. and G.P. combine in two steps; routine.

questions.key_step: A.G.P. five terms about the middle term; sum fixes d.
questions.justification: A.G.P. with ratio given; a few routine steps.

questions.key_step: Method of differences twice reduces the series to a G.P.; solve cubic in k.
questions.justification: Two rounds of the method of differences, then a cubic with a guessable root; several stages and no options to check.

questions.key_step: Each bracket is a G.P.; multiply by (1/2+1/3) to telescope.
questions.justification: Unfamiliar bracketed G.P. structure that has to be recognised and telescoped; no options, so L3.

questions.key_step: Determinant = 0 gives a cubic in sin(theta); count roots in (0,pi).
questions.justification: Determinant expansion plus cubic trig equation and a root count in an interval.

questions.key_step: ln of a G.P. is an A.P., so two columns become equal.
questions.justification: Idea that ln of a G.P. is an A.P. leads to equal columns; short but needs the insight; JEE Main style.

questions.key_step: R1->R1+R2+R3 and column differences give (a+b+c)^3; x != 0.
questions.justification: Standard determinant trick, then solve for x; three or more routine steps.

questions.key_step: Delta != 0 reduces to alpha+beta+2 != 0; test options.
questions.justification: One familiar move: compute Delta and test options; cf. 2023-P1-Q14 (L1).

questions.key_step: Delta = a^2-3; Delta=0 with Dx != 0 means inconsistent.
questions.justification: Delta then decide consistency per option; routine but several statements.

questions.key_step: Delta=0 gives k=9/2; ratios from two equations.
questions.justification: Delta = 0 gives k, then ratios; routine chain.

questions.key_step: Direct expansion collapses by sin^2+cos^2=1.
questions.justification: One expansion and sin^2+cos^2=1.

questions.key_step: Expand to a cubic with no x^2 term; sum of roots 0.
questions.justification: One expansion and Vieta's relation.

questions.key_step: D=(l+8)(2-l); at l=2 D=0 and Dx !=0.
questions.justification: Cramer's rule with four options each needing a check.

questions.key_step: D=0 for alpha, Dx=0 for beta; line needs consistency.
questions.justification: Rank and consistency understanding needed beyond Cramer's rule; routine chain.

questions.key_step: R1+R3-2R2 isolates a-2b+c=1, f constant.
questions.justification: Row operation recognising a-2b+c; routine chain.

questions.key_step: D=0 so infinitely many; solve for the direction x=2z.
questions.justification: One familiar move: D=0 then a line of solutions.
